lead: The day so far is quiet: [Meta opened Muse to third-party hardware](../summaries/72331c265890.md) and [dropped its ex-Virtue AI hires](../summaries/87ca89393b37.md), [Apple tightened Full Disk Access](../summaries/a4d7fd118037.md) because of AI agents, and [Supabase raised $150M](../summaries/af775e1a5f29.md).
